# Checked-in fixture assets: sources and licences

Fetched once in phase 00 step 10 (the one network step for checked-in fixtures; R3, D-16) from
Wikimedia Commons. Each file page states the licence below (checked 2026-10-10). All are CC0 1.0
Universal. Everything else in this folder is generated by `make.sh` or hand-written (MIT, like the repo).

| File here          | Source (Commons file page)                                                                                                                 | Author     | Licence | Processing                                                                                                      |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `faces/face-a.jpg` | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hugh_Maynard.jpg                                                                                   | HughAM     | CC0 1.0 | 900 px Commons thumbnail rescaled to 720 px wide, JPEG, metadata stripped                                       |
| `faces/face-b.jpg` | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Head_shot_Aman_TRIPATHI.jpg                                                                        | RahulTej09 | CC0 1.0 | 900 px Commons thumbnail rescaled to 720 px wide, JPEG, metadata stripped                                       |
| `sfx/tap.wav`      | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Knock_on_door.wav (original https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/28/Knock_on_door.wav) | Asud12     | CC0 1.0 | first of three knocks, 1.325 s to 1.525 s, +14 dB gain (recording is quiet), 5 ms fades, mono 48 kHz PCM 16-bit |

The portraits are used only as synthetic test inputs for face detection and layout.
Media in `media/` (`talking-head-20s.{mp4,mov,webm}`) is generated from `faces/face-a.jpg` and macOS
`say` output by `../make.sh --seed-media`; hashes in `media/SEEDS.json`.
Caption cards in `captions/` (`card-1.png` … `card-3.png`, phase 15) are drawn by `captions/cards.py`
(AppKit, Helvetica Bold) because the pinned ffmpeg has no `drawtext` (D-17); `make.sh` overlays them on
`style-extract-10s.mp4`. Generated here, MIT like the repo.
